{{Top|leg}}
'''''My Stepfather's Face: A Soldier's Secret''''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] written by [[Shaeeah Lawquane/Legends|Shaeeah Lawquane]] at the height of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It chronicled Lawquane's [[Youngling/Legends|childhood]]<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-9-battlfields-of-the-clone-wars|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 9: Battlefields of the Clone Wars}}</ref> on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]<ref name="tcwce">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> with her adopted<ref name="The Deserter Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode210.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Deserter}}</ref> [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Cut Lawquane/Legends|Cut Lawquane]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] and a deserter of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
The blog ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]]'' mistakenly identified Lawquane's homeworld as [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> instead of Saleucami.<ref name="tcwce" />
